messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P-Alert fired: /generate p99 latency > SLO for 5m (SLO burn 28%). Link: https://dash.redwood/alerts/1720077777 :rotating_light:
sam: acked on-call. I'm hopping in. tagging @alex @tanya. starting quick triage — collecting traces + check routing policies.
alex: on it. checking region heatmap -> us-west spike. traces show lots of long tail at the serving sidecar layer, not pure model time.
alex: quick command: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=serving-sidecar -o wide`
alex: snippet: `serving-sidecar-51 2/2 Running 1d 10.2.3.45  cpu 95%` — several pods on same host at high cpu, queue depth increasing.
tanya: thx. could be a partner integration sending big batched requests. any unusual batch_size metrics?
sam: pulling request-size histogram.. yes — median small but 99th batch_size jumped to 600 requests/batch for the last 10m. that's likely starving CPU + queuing.
maria: if batches are huge, sidecar batching loop holds the worker threads. we can timebox mitigation: 30m. plan: 1) mute noisy PD alerts for this page 2) reduce max_batch_size via runtime flag 3) enable fallback routing to cheaper variant for high-latency customers 4) create postmortem.
sam: doing step 1: muting PagerDuty for this alert group for 30m (will still escalate on new severity). :lock:
alex: reducing batch size now — sending admin API call:
```
POST https://admin.redwood/api/serving/flags
{ "max_batch_size": 64, "target_timebox": "30m" }
```
alex: API returned 200, propagating config.
tanya: also flipping routing for `partner-integration-X` to fallback model v1-fallback via feature flag. that avoids heavy KV cache pressure.
tanya: flag command:
`./ff-toggle --service serving --target partner-integration-X --route fallback-v1`
sam: done. traffic rerouting in progress. watch dashboards for p95/p99.
alex: checking autoscaler — no scale events yet, but nodes have pressure. I'm manually draining the overloaded host to spread pods. `kubectl drain node-42 --ignore-daemonsets`
maria: note for follow-up: consider per-tenant batch caps and backpressure signals to partners.
sam: PD note: ack on-call, suppress firing noise. we'll update status and when resolved.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by sam.
alex: good signal: p95 dropping, p99 still high but trending down from 2900ms -> 800ms. queue depth halved.
sam: nice. leaving the reduced batch_size for now. timebox for 30m and we'll roll to permanent fix in a ticket. creating follow-up: TICKET-1234 — ownership: eng-runtime, priority P2.
tanya: can we add a short customer-impact line for support? estimate: ~0.8% of requests hit >2s during peak 10m window, mostly partner-X.
maria: copying to #support for customer comms.
alex: p99 stabilized at ~400ms now, p95 ~120ms. looks resolved.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved (page cleared).
sam: closing thread. action items: TICKET-1234 (batch caps + partner rate-limiting), postmortem in 48h. thanks all. :thumbsup:
